page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-64-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The server features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 504.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. While the explicit local storage size field is designated as none, the instance configuration is provisioned with 8 local SSDs to support high-throughput storage operations. There are no graphics processing units associated with this instance type, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

As a dedicated resource instance, the virtual CPUs are not shared, ensuring consistent compute performance. No benchmark data is available to quantify specific processing, memory bandwidth, or database transaction speeds. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and integrated local SSD configuration position this server as a specialized resource-dense option, trading off GPU acceleration and standard public IPv4 allocations for high memory capacity and local storage density.

The z4d-highmem-64-highlssd server is designed for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and data-intensive transactional applications that require substantial memory capacity and local SSD performance without requiring GPU acceleration.
